name: Idoneth Deepkin - Wardens of the Chorrileum

abilities.name: Call Forth the Tsunami
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you have 3 or more chorrileum spirit points. Pick a friendly unit awaiting a summons to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with it.

abilities.name: Wrath of Mathlann
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Chorrileum Eidolon unit that has not used any Rampage abilities this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, that unit has Strike-last for the rest of the turn. The unit using this ability cannot use any other Rampage abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: The Ocean Conceals

abilities.effect: Set up the friendly Chorrileum Eidolon in reserve awaiting a summons. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Spirits of the Chorrileum
abilities.effect: Each turn, you can gain up to 1 chorrileum spirit point/ You gain 1 chorrileum spirit point the first time 1 of the following occurs in a turn: • You make an unmodified casting roll of 8 or more for a friendly Isharann Wizard • An enemy unit is destroyed while it is within 12" of any friendly Isharann units. • A friendly unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly Isharann units or while it is contesting an objective you control.

powers.name: Slipstream
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Chorrileum Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Chorrileum unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: The target can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

powers.name: Essence of the Chorrileum
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Chorrileum Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Chorrileum unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: If the target is Namarti, you can return D6 slain models to it. Otherwise, Heal (D3) the target.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing
